data.name: BioCarbon
data.description: BioCarbon is an Australian climate-tech firm that uses proprietary pyrolysis and consolidation technology to transform woody biomass waste into GreenChar, a net-zero replacement for metallurgical coke in Electric Arc Furnace steelmaking. In January 2026 it secured AU$4.8M from ARENA to build its first commercial-scale plant at Bulahdelah, NSW, which will process ~20,000 t/yr of waste woodchips into ~8,000 t/yr of renewable carbon products, and it also markets ACCU-verified biochar carbon credits.
